map.无工作但在近期积极寻找且可立即工作者，被动退出者不算失业也不算劳动力。结果仅作经: Without work but actively seeking recently and able to start immediately; those who have passively withdrawn count as neither unemployed nor in the labour force. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only, not investment advice or a policy basis; for projections and empirical estimates defer to official statistics and textbooks.
map.劳动力≤适龄人口，差额为不参与率（学生/退休/照护等）。结果仅作经济学教学与快速: The labour force is at most the working-age population, and the difference is the non-participation rate (students, retirees, carers and so on). Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only, not investment advice or a policy basis; for projections and empirical estimates defer to official statistics and textbooks.
map.非正规或低意愿就业难完全统计，官方口径以调查失业为准。结果仅作经济学教学与快速测: Informal or low-commitment employment is hard to count fully; the official measure is survey unemployment. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only, not investment advice or a policy basis; for projections and empirical estimates defer to official statistics and textbooks.
